base_member_text: [L211,L220-L222] (MED/integer-narrowing) Eight-byte integer writes narrow values to default integer before netCDF can range-check them, allowing out-of-range values to be silently corrupted.
audit_member_text: [L211,L220-L222] (MED/numeric-conversion) Eight-byte integer setters narrow values to default integer before the library can report range errors, allowing out-of-range values to be silently corrupted.

adversarial.rationale: typeSizes selects an eighteen-digit EightByteInt, but the setter passes int(values) without KIND or assigns into a default-INTEGER temporary before nf_put_att_int. Neither the generic interface nor the external declarations add range checks, so ordinary Win32 four-byte default integers lose out-of-range values before the netCDF conversion routine can inspect them.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L104-L107,L144-L147,L187-L190,L231-L234,L274-L277,L314-L317] (HIGH/buffer-capacity) Numeric array getters pass buffers to F77 routines that receive no capacity without first checking attribute length, allowing an oversized attribute to overwrite caller or temporary storage.

[L116-L118,L156-L158,L199-L202,L243-L246,L286-L288,L326-L328] (HIGH/scalar-buffer-overflow) Scalar getters read an entire attribute into a one-element temporary without verifying that the attribute contains exactly one element.
audit_member_text: [L107,L117,L147,L157,L189,L201,L233,L245,L277,L287,L317,L327] (HIGH/buffer-bounds) Numeric getters pass buffers to legacy routines without checking attribute length, so an attribute longer than the supplied array or scalar temporary can overwrite memory.

adversarial.rationale: The claimed oversized-buffer call violates the explicitly documented public API precondition: the bundled manual requires enough storage for every attribute value and directs callers to inquire about the length first. Numeric getters preserve that caller-capacity contract, and the source-tree caller search supplies no concrete violating XBeach call; missing redundant validation is not itself a HIGH library buffer defect.

base_member_text: [L117-L118,L157-L158,L189-L190,L201-L202,L233-L234,L245-L246,L287-L288,L327-L328] (MED/uninitialized-copy) Getters copy temporary outputs regardless of read status and copy full temporary arrays even when the attribute is shorter, propagating undefined values on errors or unwritten elements.
[L49-L53] (MED/inquiry-error-handling) Attribute inquiry overwrites the attnum lookup status and copies local type and length outputs even when their inquiry fails.
audit_member_text: [L49-L51] (LOW/error-propagation) The attribute-ID lookup status is unconditionally overwritten by the subsequent attribute inquiry, obscuring any distinct failure of the requested attnum lookup.

[L52-L53,L117-L118,L157-L158,L189-L190,L201-L202,L233-L234,L245-L246,L287-L288,L327-L328] (MED/undefined-value) Inquiry and getter wrappers copy uninitialized local outputs after failed calls, and integer array getters also copy undefined tail elements when the destination exceeds the attribute length.

adversarial.rationale: attnum is an output here, not an independently requested attribute-number input: both calls query exactly the same ncid, varid and name. The [F77 inquiry-family contract](https://docs.unidata.ucar.edu/netcdf-fortran/current/nc_f77_interface_guide.html) gives these two name-based inquiries the same invalid-ID/missing-attribute failure conditions, so the second inquiry preserves those failures rather than hiding a demonstrated distinct attnum lookup error; the supplied other_wording concerns a different issue.

neutralizer.quote:
function nf90_inquire_attribute(ncid, varid, name, xtype, len, attnum)
    integer,             intent( in)           :: ncid, varid
    character (len = *), intent( in)           :: name
    integer,             intent(out), optional :: xtype, len, attnum
    integer                                    :: nf90_inquire_attribute

    integer                          :: local_xtype, local_len

    ! Do we need to worry about not saving the state from this call?
    if(present(attnum)) &
      nf90_inquire_attribute = nf_inq_attid(ncid, varid, name, attnum)
    nf90_inquire_attribute   = nf_inq_att  (ncid, varid, name, local_xtype, local_len)

base_member_text: [L231-L246] (MED/integer-range) Eight-byte integer getters first convert through default-integer temporaries, unnecessarily limiting the range that the wider destination can receive.
[L66] (LOW/text-roundtrip-contract) Text attribute writes strip trailing spaces, preventing exact round trips for strings whose trailing blanks are meaningful.
